commits.subject: fix(cli): show detailed npm errors on update failure and verify installed version
commits.body:
The update command now pins the exact target version instead of @latest,
verifies the installed version after npm install, and shows the full npm
error output when installation fails. This helps diagnose why updates
get stuck on older versions.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: StanGirard
commits.subject: fix(web): use real user session data instead of hardcoded mock
commits.body:
The UserMenu component in AppHeader was displaying hardcoded 'stan@quivr.com'
instead of the actual logged-in user's email. This caused all users to see
the wrong account information.

- Fetch real user data from authClient.getSession()
- Add loading state while fetching
- Show sign-in button when not authenticated
- Wire up the sign out button to actually log out

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
